notes.title: Arena Ranking Released!
notes.content:
We've reached the milestone of over 2,000 pieces of equipment!
The ranking arena has been updated.
More challenges launched!
And now a new system for showing states, all of which are shown at once.
And when you hover your mouse over an enemy or hero, a black window will appear with all the states and buffs.

notes.title: Cards and more released!
notes.content:
It is with great joy and pride that I make the new card system available to everyone!
It's taken a long time to complete and the time has come!
There is a card menu and they will also appear in battle.
A tutorial will be added so that everyone understands how it works.

-The way enemies die has also been changed.

-The enemies' HP percentage is now shown inside the heart icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43586237/0716e2e506ad73689a1f0bbfa5da5e0b881331d4.png[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: Arena PVP released!
notes.content:
The initial version of Arean PVP has opened!
You can duel freely with registered players, even against yourself.
The Ranked version is still in development, as are weekly prizes.
PVP is not timed.

notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43586237/d181b4a7de82b7f9773054d3857fee6682926911.png[/img]

New client on Steam!
Sorry, but I think you'll have to update the game again, it may take a while depending on your connection.
your connection.
-Steam Wallet has been added (achievements and cards coming soon) @everyone
-New logos.
-All the protagonists have been changed.
-Logo and protagonist have been made by an artist.
-Login screen music removed.
-Standard npcs changed (this will continue)
-New animated click and also when you mouse over someone they will turn yellow.
-Many errors and bugs fixed.
-Halloween event started!
-Double XP event started!
-Menu, Patron and Steam buttons have been fixed and organized at the top of the screen
-Buttons have been given a new graphic
-Story mode and intro changed and many unnecessary conversations removed.
-All the original RPG Maker maps will be changed in the long term, the artist has already started the process
-The new menu for interacting with the Souls is still in development, but will be released soon
-Ultimate magic skills have gained more hits (balance improvements)

For the veterans:
Sorry I don't have much new for you, as most of the update was focused on the graphics and the existing story content.
But from the next few days I'll be more free of everything and will continue to add lots of new content.

My heartfelt thanks to all of you who are part of this community!
We're growing more and more!

notes.title: July update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43586237/d4a31c0ef429d7c19b0426c26a9ef9c9c70b9464.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43586237/0c3246962e173ddad3f1395a12bacc602c06ef28.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43586237/15a7f5a83f648db26545da6f62cea28615c56bf2.png[/img]

Master of Idols Update Report for July!

Greeting Adventures, While Alex and team plan there next move, and figure out where they are....We figured now would be a great time to let you all about the changes and updates over the last month of July!
First off We currently have a total of 18 Soul Specific Breeds, atm. Don't worry, we are still working on more, but have been busy with The Master of Idols work.. You will see as we continue...
New souls are Available in the Summon Gate, now with new option features!
Over the Last month, we have added 20 new souls to the Summon Gate! Additional we have added some options to the Gates functions. You can turn of the animations to quickly spend those Soul Tickets, to fill out your Soul Collection.

New Hunts!
9 New Hunts have been added to the Hunt board Adventrues. Find them and defeat them for special end game gear, and to bolster your gems and coins for the coming Challenges!

New War Medal Goals!
We have added 5 new Goals in the War Medals Section! Its also the only way to collect this new Card for you collection! Its the only way to get the counter card ... just saying...

Spectral Soul type Change:
By default all heroes have 100% target rate, but now all spectral have 20%, because they are supposed to be spirit/ghosts being.

Winged Soul Type Change
All Winged class gained Magic Evasion +10% by nature

Reptilian Soul Type Change
All Reptilian class gained Fever on attack by nature

Sky Arena Season 1 Is now live!
Come challenge the arena, with special enemies with special awards! Get Gems and prizes before Season 2 comes out! MMM....free Gems and special accessories!

End Game Dungeon 3 is now available for those brave enough to challenge the Idols themselves!

This dungeon features a gauntlet of monsters and fights, just for a chance to open the doors to the Idols themselves. Challenge and defeat these 4 beings to be granted a honor to fight the Idol Master himself, and if you are worth, you might even get his soul...
Now lets talk about Glory!
The Tower of Glory is now Live, currently with 385 floors to test your might against the strongest enemies in the game...currently. However, you might want to be careful as this is a Solo Challenge, so you will not being doing this with your friends. Build up your team and see if you can Rise above the Idols themselves!


There have been Loads of Minor changes in the last month, so we quickly want to cover some of them to help you all on your Journey!

Some Quick fire Changes!
New state added: Hypothermia(poison damage 1%
Now you can see enemy resistance, weakness and State immunity in battle
Updated Map Graphics for over 63 souls!
VIP Enemy now gives 22,000 SP & 2000000 Gold
Tons new Crafting Items to add to your collection!
Max HP is now 3 Million
New ATK/Mental Cap at 16 Million
Long Calm II now works until the end of combat!
Mysterious gift from checkpoint now will be available after complete story a little bit, we will see you in Marsol after a good nights rest!

Quest Journal Has been Added with a New Battle UI!
Gain Co-Op coins for battle

Golden Bullet or Gunners now has AoE!
You can use emojis using Win + Period
New recovery potions added to Bambal
New Items in the Special Store!


Lastly, the weapons you hold will be undergoing some changes.
All physical skills now will bond with weapon, for instance, if my weapon add poison, so the skill will add poison.

July has been a busy month! Lets see what the next month hold for Fantasy World Souls!

Thank you to the entire team and players for making this game amazing for everyone!
